en: Why? Because of the stirrup, the rider could stand on his horse, and shoot arrows in a full 360 degrees, dominating his opponent. Combined with that powerful bow, they had a famous tactic called the Parthian shot — the moment you thought they were retreating and chased them, they'd turn around and put an arrow in you.
zh: 為什麼呢?因為由於馬燈的緣故 那個騎馬的人能夠站在馬背上 而他可以在360度去射箭 去壓制著對方 因為有馬燈有這麼強的弓 所以有一招很出名的就是回馬戰 你不要以為它敗走你追著它 它轉頭就可以拿你命了

en: The author is quite famous — a four-star general, and the former CIA Director.
zh: 這個人寫的其實是很出名的 就是他是一個四星上將來的 也都是CIA的前局長

en: Looking at these weapons, you can see the technology is quite advanced.
zh: 從這些武器裡面 你可以看到科技相當先進

en: Personally, looking around at how things are developing today — this U.S.-Israel-Iran war has many implications politically.
zh: 我自己覺得 環顧現在發展的情況 當然這次的美國、以色列、伊朗的戰爭 還有很多啟發的 在政治上

en: When a drone is launched into the sky, it stays in contact with its operator via radio waves.
zh: 其實就是當一個無人機 它放了上天空的時候 它就是透過一些電波 跟這個控制員保持聯絡的

en: There's a scene like this: A CIA female analyst finds bin Laden hiding in Pakistan.
zh: 其中有這樣的一幕的 話說這個中央情報局的女探員 就找到這個賓拉登藏在巴基斯坦

en: For Europe, for NATO, for Israel's place in the Middle East — those we can leave for another time.
zh: 比如對於歐洲、對於北約 另外對於以色列在中東的位置 這些留待日後有機會再講

en: Not just that — on day one they killed 48 senior generals and important leaders.
zh: 不僅如此 在第一天裡面已經殺了 48個高級的將領和一些重要的領袖

en: For example, you may have seen the recent news about Facebook, Meta, and other platforms being fined by the courts for using algorithms to learn what people like and feed them content to keep them addicted.
zh: 比如你現在看到最近有個新聞就是 比如Facebook、Meta或者其它有些 是被法庭罰它 說它就是用一些的algorithm 用一些的訊息去知道那些人喜歡些什麼 那就供一些東西給它看 就讓它上癮

en: The picture at the bottom left is a torpedo — a Mk 48 heavyweight torpedo.
zh: 左手邊下面那張就是 那個是一個鱼雷來的 一個Mk 48超重的鱼雷

en: That was the first revolution in warfare and in weapons.
zh: 這個就是第一次的 在戰爭上、武器上的革命

en: Now, facing these unmanned weapons, there are counter-strategies too.
zh: 好了 面對著這些無人的武器 其實都有對策的

en: So unlike nuclear weapons, the materials here are more widespread and far easier to proliferate.
zh: 所以有別於核子武器 就是那些材料是更加普遍 更加容易擴散

en: The one next to it — that's like Shake Shack's — robots that deliver documents and food.
zh: 另外旁邊那個就是Shake Shack的那些 送文件、送食物的機器人

en: Last year, there was a scene like this: some Russian soldiers surrendered — they surrendered to a unit, but that unit had no human in it.
zh: 在上年裏面就曾經有這樣的一幕的 就是有一些俄羅斯的軍人 他就投降了 他就向一些部隊投降 但是那些部隊是沒有真人的

en: Something like this?
zh: 會不會是這樣的呢?

en: What does that mean? He said: in the end, winning a war doesn't come down to how many drones a country has, how many unmanned weapons — it comes down to how those unmanned weapons make decisions.
zh: 什麼意思呢?他就說了 其實最後打贏一場仗 不在乎那個國家它擁有多少無人機 多少無人武器 而是在乎那些無人的武器是怎樣決策的

en: And Ukraine today — if you search online, you'll find they can manufacture millions of drones per year.
zh: 而現在的烏克蘭呢 其實你上網找一下 它每年可以製作的無人機是數以百萬計的

en: So what was the first weapons revolution?
zh: 第一次的武器的革命是什麼呢?

en: For example, look at COVID-19 — all along, some people didn't want anyone tracing its origin.
zh: 比如現在你看見就是 COVID-19 這樣 一直以來都 有些人不想人追查那個源頭

en: I saw one being tested on the street — and here's what's special: it has no steering wheel.
zh: 那我在街上看到他試車 這個就是特別之處了 就是沒有胎盤的

en: Closer to reality, there's Big Dog, with a gun mounted on top, or some tracked robots.
zh: 近似一些現實的就是比如Big Dog 在上面有一支槍 又或者有一些履帶的機器人

en: So why use a heavyweight torpedo against it?
zh: 那為什麼會用到超重魚雷去對付它呢?

en: And in the upper-right corner, that one is a laser cannon.
zh: 另外在這個右手邊的上角 那個就是激光炮

en: I think war serves as a kind of stage — one where you can see how astonishing human invention can be.
zh: 我覺得戰爭是一個平台 你可以看到人在這方面的發明是很厲害的

en: But at least you know that in January and February, remember how the U.S. was still talking about a topic — wanting to acquire Greenland, to complete its Golden Dome defense plan.
zh: 但是起碼你知道在1月、2月的時候 是不是美國還在講一個話題 就是想拿這個格陵蘭 完成它那個金窮頂的防禦計劃

en: The result is obvious.
zh: 所以那個成績是很顯然的

en: Now they can produce millions of drones a year.
zh: 到現在一年可以出數以百萬計的無人機
